tools.compiler:
Ubuntu clang version 18.1.3 (1ubuntu1)
Target: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /usr/bin

exclusions: external dependencies and generated files: only src/ is selected
compile/link boundary executables are not production targets

applicability.linux: Clang 18 LLVM instrumentation, x86_64, Qt 6.4.2 offscreen; exact four-metric counts.
applicability.windows: Native static Windows state, sharing and metadata journeys are required in a separate CI job. Native coverage is unmeasured; Windows-only executable paths remain a qualification gap. No incompatible profile merging.
applicability.remaining_gaps: All measured uncovered lines, functions, regions and decisions are retained per file in gate.json; unreachable/platform decisions require review and are not automatically excluded.
